content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Guwahati Associate Project Engineer Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati Associate Project Engineer position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Associate Project Engineer post at IIT Guwahati is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Engineering/ Design/ Architecture or a Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Design with at least 3 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Associate Project Engineer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 49,000 plus 16% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Associate Project Engineer role?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Associate Project Engineer announced by IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Associate Project Engineer is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Assam apply?
faq.answer: The notification mentions applications are invited from eligible candidates in Assam, but it is advisable to check the detailed notification for specific eligibility regarding domicile.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is IITG/II&SI/Project Staff Rectt-2026/145.
